decision.question: How does the explorer avoid probing module folders?
options: filter the 404s in the shared loader
walk() gets an into(rel) filter; the Explorer looks only into doc/
decision.why: The loader is shared; the explorer only needs the readme, sibling .md and doc/**/*.md.

finish.result: check_page on core/Page/md, ux/Dictate/md, ext/Mention/md: http_errors 0, failed 0, page_errors 0 each. A fresh worktree lacks git-ignored directory.json/tasks.json/page-work.json and shows false 404s until copied in.
